items.html: *ZA has in him ten complete Sefirot, only they are in the secret of concealment and only the VAK are discernible; but certainly there must be in him complete ten Sefirot. And behold, it is known that the days of the Ibur are only eight months, for one day taken from the ninth month suffices, as is known; and even that day, its main taking is because of the doubt of the day of absorption, as is known. It is therefore found that the principal months of the Ibur that are needed are only eight months.
